concerns.text: Task T003 only records a bootstrap LR p‑value (SC‑002) but does not verify the HMM log‑likelihood improvement ≥ 10 points over a 1‑state baseline nor the EM convergence change < 1e‑4 within 100 iterations, violating SC‑002 and effectively weakening FR‑003.
Tasks T001 and T002 make no mention of setting or recording fixed random seeds, breaching Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which mandates seeds be pinned in code.

Task T008’s verification checks only for a successful notebook exit status; it does not measure or enforce execution time, leaving SC‑003 (runtime‑budget check) and SC‑007 (notebook completes within free‑tier window) untestable.
